slot_semantics: Two independent inventory slots. For each occupied slot, render the actual corresponding SBW mine ItemStack/model at its named anchor; for an empty slot render nothing. Do not render an additional static mine.
sbw_asset_status: Actual SBW mine assets and item IDs were not provided; final item display transform and scale must be fitted to the actual SBW renderer during mod integration.
model_scope: Cosmetic exterior game art only. No gameplay, inventory, detonation or mine mechanics implemented.
